title: Bazeen
description: Bazeen is a Libya classic prepared with pearl barley, barley flour, lamb, tomato paste. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Home bazeen uses the available barley flour and a spiced lamb sauce; texture and serving differ from traditional communal bazeen.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 20 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Add barley flour gradually to simmering water, beating vigorously to a stiff smooth dough; mound the cooked paste on a platter.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 25 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Boil the eggs for about 10 minutes, cool promptly in cold water, peel and prepare as required.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
